problem_statement: Current WP301 preserves deterministic arithmetic and evidence refs but does not encode whether heterogeneous axis score magnitudes are semantically commensurate. The current overlap_count also treats every score_bp > 0 as a full discrete support axis. WP302 then promotes max(weighted_score_bp) into familiarity_bp, so an unbound score contract can propagate into later attention priority even when aggregate arithmetic itself is tamper-resistant.

design_decision.name: WP301_RETRIEVAL_FUSION_CONTRACT_V2
design_decision.principle: Separate score semantics from rank semantics; bind every derived signal to its producer/calibration identity; make support/overlap semantics explicit; keep all fusion outputs derived and non-authoritative.
design_decision.reason: The needed mechanism is small deterministic control-plane logic. Importing a search server/framework would add state, dependency and runtime cost without improving canonical authority.

RetrievalSignalWitness.identity_rule: Witness contents participate in RetrievalSignal/candidate/plan digests. Same numeric score from a different scorer/calibration/version is a different derived observation.
RetrievalSignalWitness.local_precedent: ContextCostWitness already binds tokenizer/renderer/source-revision/content identities before trusting a derived token count. WP301 score evidence should have an analogous provenance contract.

modes.CALIBRATED_SCORE_V1: Retain weighted integer score fusion only when every participating soft-evidence axis declares a compatible score semantics/scale/calibration contract. Incompatible or unknown contracts fail closed rather than being averaged because they share a 0..10000 range.
modes.ORDINAL_RRF_V1: Use deterministic reciprocal-rank fusion only when ranked evidence is available but score magnitudes are not demonstrably commensurate. Fixed rank_constant/window, deterministic ties and unique evidence-dimension identities are mandatory. Its fused number is ordering evidence only, never a relevance probability/basis-point familiarity value.

hard_before_fusion: generation/provenance identity required by caller integration
soft_after_admission: confidence or other explicitly derived relevance axes
hard_gate_soft_signal_split.invariant: No rank/score/fusion result may resurrect an inadmissible or superseded memory.

overlap_semantics_delta.proposed: Axis support is true only when score_bp >= explicit presence_threshold_bp for that axis/policy. The threshold identity is part of policy_sha256.
overlap_semantics_delta.reason: Prevents an accidental zero-to-one basis-point discontinuity from receiving the same full discrete overlap bonus as meaningful support while preserving the project's multi-evidence overlap concept.
overlap_semantics_delta.compatibility: Do not silently reinterpret v1 plans. Introduce a versioned v2 policy/plan digest; v1 receipts remain historical/replayable under v1 semantics.

required: CALIBRATED_SCORE_V1 may expose familiarity_bp only if its calibration contract explicitly states that weighted_score_bp has the required familiarity-compatible semantics.
ORDINAL_RRF_V1 must NOT convert RRF consensus score into familiarity_bp.

When no familiarity-compatible calibrated score exists, emit an explicit unavailable/unknown familiarity state rather than manufacturing zero as epistemic equivalence to known-zero unless the existing WP302 API intentionally defines zero as no admitted familiarity evidence.
wp302_dependency_delta.reason: Rank consensus and calibrated magnitude are different evidence types; downstream attention must preserve that distinction.

lexical.note: Bind tokenizer/query/config/source revision and score semantics before score fusion; otherwise use ordinal mode.

vector.risk: Pinned upstream README identifies the project as pre-v1 with breaking changes expected; isolate behind a narrow adapter and do not make F2 schema/authority depend on it.

acceptance_tests_for_trigger4: Existing WP301 determinism/order-invariance/supersession/provenance tests remain green under v1 compatibility.
V2 CALIBRATED_SCORE rejects two axes whose scale_id/calibration contract is incompatible even when both numeric values are 0..10000.
V2 signal/candidate/plan digest changes when generator/calibration/version identity changes while numeric score stays identical.
Explicit support threshold reproduces and closes the 1-bp overlap discontinuity for a policy whose meaningful-support threshold exceeds 1 bp.
Threshold is itself versioned/evidence-bound and deterministic; no hidden heuristic threshold.
ORDINAL_RRF result is invariant to input insertion order with deterministic per-axis ties.
Duplicate/correlated evidence-dimension IDs cannot be counted twice without an explicit distinct-dimension identity.
RRF rank_constant and rank_window_size are fixed in policy identity; changing either changes policy/plan digest.
WP302 refuses to interpret ORDINAL_RRF consensus score as familiarity_bp.
A calibrated-score result may feed WP302 familiarity only with an explicit familiarity-compatible score contract.
Superseded/inadmissible memory cannot become eligible in either fusion mode.
Derived FTS/vector indexes can be deleted/rebuilt without changing UnifiedDB canonical memory authority.

reproduce: Exact current v1 one-basis-point overlap inversion from the pinned formula.
Same case under an explicit support threshold to show the discontinuity is policy-controlled rather than implicit.
RRF duplicate-dimension arithmetic showing why evidence-dimension identity/deduplication is required.

resource_effect_prediction.cpu: small deterministic metadata/hash/validation overhead; bounded O(candidates * axes)
resource_effect_prediction.expected_net: Higher evidence integrity and replayability at low runtime cost; exact overhead must be measured by Trigger4 before acceptance.

counterhypotheses_preserved: Existing caller may already guarantee cross-axis calibration; trace producers before forcing schema migration.
A pure RRF replacement may improve robustness to incomparable scores but loses magnitude information needed by familiarity/abstention; therefore not adopted wholesale.
A full search framework could provide mature fusion operators but creates unnecessary dependency/state surface relative to a thin local contract.
impact_surface: UnifiedDB schema only if fusion traces/witnesses are durably journaled; any derived index remains rebuildable/non-authoritative
explicit_non_goals: No change to canonical UnifiedDB truth authority.
No automatic import of sqlite-vec, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or another search framework.
No runtime/whole-system/physical GRID10 credit from this mapping.

promotion_decision.reason: The architecture delta is source-grounded but the principal discontinuity should be independently reproduced and the RRF duplicate-dimension risk demonstrated before build handoff.
